title: Loughaunbeg East, Inverin, Co Galway., H91VW6V
seoTitle: Loughaunbeg East, Inverin, Co Galway., H91VW6V
description:
O’Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are privileged to bring to market one of the most beautiful residential properties in the stunning location of Coast Road, Inverin, Co. Galway. 

Loughaunbeg East is a spectacular detached bungalow home offering an abundance of accommodation & turn-key condition throughout. 

Constructed in 2009, the gated entrance & stone walled frontage leads to a deceptively large home with approximately 256.sqm of living space & thoughtful design which is evident immediately upon entry. 

The property comprises of five sizeable bedrooms, two consisting of their own en-suites, three further bathrooms & stunning open concept living area with adjacent service & storage spaces. 

The design allows the home to avail of plentiful natural light with & overlooking the beautiful grounds encompassing the home. 

Additionally, Loughaunbeg East offers a separate double garage with an upper mezzanine which is connected via a neat shelter. 

Externally, the home is positioned on approximately 0.69 acre boasting manicured lawns, mature greenery, patio area, off-street parking & stunning surroundings. 

Ideally situated just off the sought after Connemara Coast Road, the detached home is an idyllic setting with picturesque surroundings.  Whilst offering a peaceful setting, the residence is well positioned for all amenities nearby, including primary & secondary schools, with proximity to Inverin & Spiddal, as well as direct & quick access to Galway City. 

Nearby beaches & shoreline are within easy reach expected of the coastal locale. 

Loughaunbeg East is a perfect home ideal for a variety of purchasers & will prove to be an ideal family home allowing potential new owners to acquire turn-key condition, abundance of accommodation, spacious living area & an idyllic location. 

Viewing is highly recommended & guaranteed not to disappoint.
